snippet.title: 💥🔫 Shoot, Hack, Grind | Last Man Sitting | Demo now available! 💥🔫
snippet.description:
Last Man Sitting is all about shooting, hacking and grinding your way through waves of sentient office appliances (or your IRL colleagues) in a'00s- inspired, action packed roguelite arena shooter. Launches Spring 2026, TRY THE FREE DEMO NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/774291/Last_Man_Sitting/

Dear future colleagues, we are beyond thrilled to share the latest leadership initiative and corporate expansion: The Last Man Sitting Demo during Steam PvP Fest! The demo features not only one but two major game modes: PvE Swarm mode and PvP Arena mode. Not only that, but we are also working to implement Co-op* mode for PvE Swarm really soon, stay tuned for an updated demo! 

*Coming soon to the demo. Follow us on socials for more info about the release.
